title: Boss SY-300 Guitar Synthesizer

controlChangeCommands.name: Bank Select
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Bank Select MSB (CC0). FIX map: 0=U01-U99 (PC 0-98), 1=P01-P70 (PC 0-69); LSB (CC32) received as 0. CC1-31 and CC64-95 are user-assignable via patch CTL/EXP Assign (SOURCE NUMBER); no fixed factory CC map.

additionalInfo: 5-pin DIN MIDI IN and OUT/THRU. Clock/transport sync requires SYSTEM > MIDI > SYNC CLOCK set to AUTO, MIDI (AUTO), or USB (AUTO). MAP SELECT FIX vs PROG changes PC-to-patch mapping.
